title: useNavigation
summary: Observe page-level pending state without mixing it with independent fetcher state.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no arguments and requires RouterProvider. The application mounting helpers also install retained-view navigation, which exposes the pending destination.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns { state, location }. state is idle, loading, or submitting. location is the pending URL under either RouterProvider or mountApplication, and undefined when idle. Retained navigation keeps the visible URL separate until the destination commits.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Use page navigation state for page-level feedback. A fetcher has its own state and should render its own pending feedback.

sections.title: Retained views
sections.body: During a retained navigation, the displayed page and its data remain together until the destination can commit. Use location for the pending destination when present; useURLLocation describes the visible snapshot. This hook does not expose formData, formMethod, or a nested match list.
